name: combobox-field
title: Combobox Field
description: `Combobox` bound to a form field, for `createAppForm` or inside `form.AppField`: a string field, or a `string[]` one with `multiple`. The choice with a search box, a list that fills when it opens, a note in it, or several values. `ComboboxField`, kept out of `form` so a form of plain inputs does not install the popover and the command list.
